clips.title: The story
paras: Blackwolf River is a waterway flowing out of Cragpool Lake down through Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Once a clean mountain stream, its waters have become thoroughly polluted by the Venture Company's aggressive logging and industrial operations.

Descending from Cragpool Lake, the Blackwolf River cuts across the basin of Windshear Crag. What should be a pristine alpine tributary has instead borne the brunt of unchecked goblin enterprise. As the Venture Company clears the surrounding woodlands with heavy machinery and buzzsaws, sludge, oil, and logging waste leach steadily into the current. The despoiled river stands as a vivid example of the commercial plunder threatening Stonetalon's wilderness.
